statements.t: The oil and natural gas industry is cyclical and commodity prices are highly volatile and we expect continued and increased pricing volatility in the crude oil and natural gas markets.
We expect to be able to issue additional equity and debt securities from time to time as market conditions allow to facilitate future acquisitions.
Our development efforts and capital for 2027 is anticipated to focus on a mix of drilling Oswego and Mancos wells.

During the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026 , we spent approximately $239.6 million on drilling and completion activities and related equipment , $44.5 million on remedial workovers and other capital projects and $14.1 million on midstream and other property and equipment capital projects.

We could choose to defer a portion of these planned capital expenditures depending on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, the success of our drilling activities, prevailing and anticipated prices for oil and natural gas, the availability of necessary equipment, including acid to be used for our acid stimulation completion, infrastructure and capital, the receipt and timing of required regulatory…

A deferral of planned capital expenditures, particularly with respect to drilling and completing new wells, could result in a reduction in anticipated production and cash flows and reduce our cash available for distribution to unitholders.
We expect to fulfill the delivery commitments primarily with production from proved developed reserves.

We paid approximately $3.2 million and $8.0 million in operating lease payments for the three and nine month periods ended September 30, 2026, respectively, and expect to pay approximately $24.0 million in operating lease payments through 2031.
Our presentation of Adjusted EBITDA should not be construed as an inference that our results will be unaffected by unusual items.

statements.t: Ward continued, “The durable asset base we have built since 2018 through nearly two dozen disciplined acquisitions will continue to reward our unitholders.
With 2.8 million acres and years of high-quality inventory across three world-class basins, we have optimized our 2027 plan around the favorable oil outlook.
We will allocate the vast majority of capital to our Oswego play and remain opportunistic on the material gas upside of our portfolio.
We are confident in the flexibility of our business model and look forward to distinguished cash returns in 2027.”
Today the Company provided guidance for full-year 2027.
